title: Your Body Produces 2 Pools of Saliva?
hook: 3 Human Body Science for Kids facts they never teach you
script: Did you know your body produces enough saliva in your lifetime to fill two swimming pools? That's just one mind-blowing fact about your incredible human body! Every single day, your heart beats about 100,000 times, pumping blood through a network of vessels over 60,000 miles long – enough to wrap around the Earth more than twice! Your brain, though only 2% of your body weight, consumes a whopping 20% of your body's oxygen and calories. It's constantly working, even when you sleep, processing dreams and consolidating memories. And get this: your body replaces its entire outer layer of skin every 27 days! That means you're literally a new you, skin-wise, nearly every month. Your bones are stronger than steel, yet remarkably light. They're constantly rebuilding themselves, a process that takes about 10 years for a complete skeleton turnover. These are just a few of the incredible feats your body performs without you even noticing, making you wonder: did you know your body produces enough saliva in your lifetime to fill two swimming pools?
